basics.name: Hiruna Vishwamith
basics.label: FPGA Design Engineer · Computer Architecture & AI Acceleration
basics.summary: Electronics & Telecommunications engineer working at the intersection of computer architecture, reconfigurable computing, and AI acceleration. I design and verify processors and accelerators from RTL to FPGA — including a quad-core out-of-order RISC-V machine, verified in lock-step against a golden model, that boots Linux SMP — and I map modern AI models onto custom hardware. 5 peer-reviewed publications (IEEE HPEC, CHEP, ISARC, INTCEC).

projects.name: Chiron — Quad-Core Out-of-Order RISC-V Processor
projects.summary: A quad-core out-of-order RV64IMA processor in Chisel: four OoO harts with register renaming, an 8-entry issue queue and a 16-entry ROB per core, 4-table TAGE branch prediction, and split L1s behind an AXI-ACE coherent interconnect and a shared non-blocking L2. Verified instruction-by-instruction in lock-step against a golden C++ model in both single-core and 4-hart modes; passes all 84 official RISC-V ISA tests, boots Linux SMP to an interactive shell, and is deployed to an AMD Virtex UltraScale+ (VCU118) FPGA. Exposes 164 hardware performance counters; reaches 0.946 aggregate quad-core IPC and a 3.92x matmul speedup over the single-core baseline. Grew out of the final-year multicore project I led at the University of Moratuwa.

projects.name: Talos — Cycle-Accurate Systolic Array Simulator
projects.summary: A cycle-accurate systolic-array and dataflow simulator in pure Python that steps a real PE mesh one clock at a time and accounts for every MAC, wire hop, stalled cycle and picojoule. Models three dataflows (output-, weight- and input-stationary), fp32/bf16/int8 MAC semantics, a bandwidth-limited DRAM behind an LRU scratchpad, and energy/area across seven process nodes. Produces an efficiency waterfall, roofline, energy breakdown, Pareto design-space search and a quantified bottleneck advisor; validated against published TPUv1 silicon (91.75 vs. 92 peak TOPS).

projects.name: ASTRA — LEO Satellite Network Simulator
projects.summary: A physics-accurate Low Earth Orbit constellation simulator in pure C11 with a hand-rolled OpenGL renderer. Couples real Kepler orbital mechanics to per-timestep routing (Dijkstra, distance-vector); validated to machine precision (3e-12 km orbital parity, bit-exact routing over 30k+ paths) and ThreadSanitizer-clean.

projects.name: Parameterized SIMD Processor for Matrix Operations
projects.summary: A fully parameterized SIMD processor with a custom ISA for matrix multiplication, addition, and subtraction, built on a 4-stage pipeline in Verilog and deployed on a ZYBO Z7 FPGA with AXI/DMA integration.
